skill.name: developer-growth-analysis
skill.description: Analyze recent Claude Code chat history to identify coding patterns, skill gaps, learning resources, and Slack-ready developer growth reports.
skill.summary: Turns recent Claude Code chats into a personalized developer growth report with recommended learning resources.
skill.author: Joseph OBrien

security_audit.summary: Most external command findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks in examples and inline field names. The real risks are hidden Claude Code history access and external sharing of chat-derived analysis through Slack and HackerNews search workflows.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before reading ~/.claude/history.jsonl. Disclose fields read, allow a time range, and support pasted or redacted input.
Make Slack delivery opt-in for each run. Preview the report first and redact secrets, project names, and pasted content details.

remediation.issue: External searches from private work context
remediation.suggestion: Review HackerNews search queries before sending them externally. Keep queries generic and remove customer names, repository names, and proprietary terms.

content.user_title: Analyze Developer Growth From Recent Chats
content.value_statement: Developers often miss patterns in their daily coding work. This skill turns recent Claude Code chats into focused growth feedback, learning resources, and a Slack-ready report.
actual_capabilities: Reads recent Claude Code chat history from the local history file.
Identifies projects, technologies, problem types, and repeated challenges.
Prioritizes three to five specific improvement areas with evidence.
Generates a structured developer growth report with action items.
Finds HackerNews learning resources related to improvement areas.
Formats and sends the report to the user through Slack DMs.
limitations: Requires access to local Claude Code history.
May include sensitive work context unless the report is reviewed first.
Learning resource quality depends on HackerNews search results.
Cannot evaluate code quality beyond what appears in chat history.

use_cases.title: Weekly Developer Retrospective
use_cases.description: Review recent work patterns and choose one practical improvement goal for the next week.

use_cases.title: Coaching Preparation
use_cases.description: Summarize recurring challenges before a mentoring session or engineering growth discussion.

use_cases.title: Focused Learning Plan
use_cases.description: Convert recent debugging and implementation struggles into a short reading and practice plan.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Growth Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my developer growth from the last 24 hours. Show the report before sending anything externally.

prompt_templates.title: Target One Skill Area
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my recent chats for backend development patterns. Identify my top three improvement areas and matching learning resources.

prompt_templates.title: Weekly Learning Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my last 48 hours of Claude Code work. Prioritize improvement areas, strengths, and three action items for next week.

prompt_templates.title: Redacted Slack Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my recent work, redact project identifiers, draft a Slack report, and ask for approval before any external send.

output_examples.input: Analyze my developer growth from today.
output_examples.output: A concise report summarizing recent work, observed strengths, prioritized improvement areas, and recommended next actions.

output_examples.input: Find learning resources for the gaps in my recent TypeScript work.
output_examples.output: A reading list grouped by improvement area, with short explanations of why each resource matches the observed pattern.

output_examples.input: Prepare a Slack summary, but ask before sending it.
output_examples.output: A Slack-ready draft with redacted project details and a clear approval step before delivery.

best_practices: Review the generated report before sending it to Slack.
Choose a narrow time window to reduce unrelated or sensitive context.
Redact customer names, repository names, credentials, and private project details.
anti_patterns: Do not run it after sensitive work without reviewing the source history.
Do not treat the report as a formal performance evaluation.
Do not auto-send reports externally without explicit approval.

faq.question: What data does this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It analyzes recent Claude Code chat history, including requests, project names, timestamps, and pasted content references.

faq.question: Does it send data externally?
faq.answer: Yes, it can use HackerNews searches and Slack delivery through Rube MCP. Review content before any external action.

faq.question: Can I limit the analysis window?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask for a specific period, such as today, yesterday, or the last 48 hours.

faq.question: Will it replace a code review?
faq.answer: No. It reviews chat patterns and learning needs, not the full correctness or security of your code.

faq.question: Who is this best for?
faq.answer: It is best for developers who use Claude Code regularly and want evidence-based growth feedback.

faq.question: How should I use the report?
faq.answer: Pick one improvement area, study the recommended resources, and apply one action item during the next week.
